project.title: HTML5 Boilerplate official release source review
project.summary:
The 404 page text content must contain Page Not Found and the missing page apology
Home page content must say Hello world and identify HTML5 Boilerplate
The page content must declare English in a nonempty html lang attribute on both delivered pages
Home page content must have a nonempty document title identifying a business name
Home page copy must state a 48 hour cancellation notice rule and a refund eligibility policy
A request for a nonexistent route must return HTTP 404 and render the delivered 404 page
Mobile visitors at 375px must read the 404 page without clipped content
The 404 page content must include a linked Return home phrase targeting index.html

404.html has lang="en", but index.html declares an empty lang attribute.
Index document title is empty; no business name is present.
Index body contains only the Hello world line; no cancellation notice or refund policy copy.

risks.title: Homepage html lang attribute is empty
risks.explanation: index.html declares lang="" instead of a nonempty English declaration.

risks.title: Homepage document title is empty
risks.explanation: index.html has an empty title element, providing no business name.
risks.suggestion: Add a nonempty title with the business name.

risks.title: Homepage lacks cancellation and refund policy copy
risks.explanation: Index body contains only the Hello world line, without 48-hour notice or refund eligibility text.
risks.suggestion: Add homepage copy stating the 48 hour cancellation notice rule and refund eligibility policy.

risks.title: 404 page lacks Return home link to index.html
risks.explanation: 404.html body has only an h1 and a paragraph; no linked 'Return home' phrase is present.
risks.suggestion: Add an anchor with text 'Return home' targeting index.html on 404.html.
